string.text: Debug
Shared debug logging, on-screen overlay, and feature test keys. Leave logging on if you are reporting a bug.
Reset all D.O.G.M.A. to defaults
Queue every D.O.G.M.A. option to its built-in default (orange / pending), same as MCM Default. Accept to apply, Reset to discard. Does not touch other mods.
All D.O.G.M.A. options queued to defaults — Accept to apply.
Enable debug logging
Writes D.O.G.M.A. debug lines to xray_*.log under appdata/logs. On by default.
Enable debug overlay
On-screen D.O.G.M.A. debug overlay used by features that support it.
Radiation
Debug add radiation
Development keybind: add a chunk of radiation to the actor for testing grain FX.
Debug clear radiation
Development keybind: clear the actor's radiation.
Fast Travel
Path preview on PDA
Show the route on the PDA when you right-click a destination, before you start travelling.
Debug sneaking +
Development keybind: increase Sneaking skill level by 1.
Debug sneaking -
Development keybind: decrease Sneaking skill level by 1.
Rebuild coarse nav on load
When on, always rebuild this level's coarse nav on load (ignores a valid cache). Off = load cache if valid; build and save only when missing or stale.
Debug rebuild nav
Development keybind: force-rebuild this level's coarse nav graph and overwrite the cache.
Show coarse nav mesh on PDA

Draw this level's coarse travel graph on the PDA map while open. Blue = nodes, grey = a few midpoints on the straight chord between linked nodes (connectivity only), green = travel anchors. Turn off when done.
FPS
If a frame takes longer than this to complete, log a warning (search xray log for 'LONG FRAME WARNING!'). Requires debug logging.
